placement.subject: Urgent
placement.notice:
CDC will start the ERP registration for placement 2026-27 from 17th August 2026 (from 11:00 AM onwards).

Students have to complete their placement registration process (CV building) within 25th August 2026 (11:59 PM). No further extension will be provided.

All the potential eligible students will be provided two consecutive registration windows i.e. one in the month of August, 2026 (for first phase till December) and another in the month of January, 2027 (for second phase till March). By registering in the month of August they can participate in Phase - I placement session i.e in December and by registering in the month of January they can participate in Phase - II placement i.e. from January to March. It is the choice of the students in which phase (Phase - I in December and Phase - II from January to March) they wish to register.

However, once a student is graduated from the Institute he/she will not be permitted to participate in any further placement process, even though he/ she has not availed two opportunities or availed but not placed.

All the students who have accepted the PPO are strictly advised to register for CDC placement, otherwise in CDC placement data their names will be missed out.

Students are advised to keep their CV content ready along with the relevant documents which are required to be uploaded for further verification.

CDC will start the ERP registration for placement 2026-27 from 17th August 2026 (from 11:00 AM onwards).

Students have to complete their placement registration process (CV building) within 25th August 2026 (11:59 PM). No further extension will be provided.

All the potential eligible students will be provided two consecutive registration windows i.e. one in the month of August, 2026 (for first phase till December) and another in the month of January, 2027 (for second phase till March). By registering in the month of August they can participate in Phase - I placement session i.e in December and by registering in the month of January they can participate in Phase - II placement i.e. from January to March. It is the choice of the students in which phase (Phase - I in December and Phase - II from January to March) they wish to register.

However, once a student is graduated from the Institute he/she will not be permitted to participate in any further placement process, even though he/ she has not availed two opportunities or availed but not placed.

All the students who have accepted the PPO are strictly advised to register for CDC placement, otherwise in CDC placement data their names will be missed out.

Students are advised to keep their CV content ready along with the relevant documents which are required to be uploaded for further verification.

Students are advised to note the followings:1) For hall related activities - concerned Warden / Asst. Warden may be approached.2) For Gymkhana related activities including inter IIT-President of Gymkhana may be approached.3) For activities of various societies- Concerned Head of the Society may be approached.4) For any activities from outside the institute, including competitions, best paper and conference etc.- mail copy of CONFIRMED PARTICIPATION and congratulatory mail for wining best papers / any prizes, E-certificate is to be uploaded.5) Project done under In house Faculty (other than academic requirement) - relevant certificate from the Faculty is to be uploaded.6) Publication: First page of publication/ acceptance of review email/ acceptance letter.7) Departmental activities/ Student council activities- Relevant proof from concerned Head/ Faculty is to be uploaded.8) All PORs should be certified properly with the supporting documents.9) Students are prohibited from mentioning any kind of rank of entrance exams (JEE / GATE / JAM etc.) and current departmental rank in the CV.10) Students are also not allowed to mention the his/her position (percentage / percentile) in JEE / GATE / JAM etc. in the CV.11) Other rank mentioned like code challenge rank etc.- is to supported by mail from the company domain/ certificate.12) Any scholarship is to be supported with proper authenticate documents.13) For M.

Tech students - B.

Tech projects done elsewhere - proper certificate is to be attached.14) For Internship Completion Certificate - Duly signed CDC Internship completion form (format attached) / Duly signed internship completion certificate of a company / duly signed internship completion certificate from the Research Guide of the Research , Educational Institute / Email from the HR or Team Manager (Mail must be from company domain , company email id with designation and mobile number).15) The size of the PDF must be less than 300 KB to be uploaded in ERP.
